messages:
amy: Quick proposal 1: refactor our incident comms templates so theyre easier to use during a pager. Goals: fewer edits under pressure, clear enterprise escalation paths, and consistent status-page copy.

leo: +1. can you outline the new structure? happy to copy into the playbook.

amy: Proposed structure (order enforced):
 - Header: {{INCIDENT_ID}} | severity | start {{START_TS}}
 - One-line summary (for status page)
 - Customer impact (who/how many/what features)
 - What we know (facts only)
 - What were doing (actions + ETA)
 - Workarounds for customers (if any)
 - Enterprise escalation (account rep + SLA)
 - Internal notes reference (link)
 - Contact for updates

amy: Also adding a short "on-call checklist" that incident-bot can auto-insert: verify metrics, confirm scope, choose tone, confirm legal line, confirm enterprise ping.

leo: Love the checklist. For "severity" we should surface recommended tone and status-page cadence (e.g., SEV1: updates every 15m, SEV2: 30m).

amy: Agree. Mapping suggestion: SEV1 -> "empathetic" + 15m updates; SEV2 -> "concise" + 30m; SEV3 -> "concise" + 60m.

fiona: From support: make sure the customer-facing message includes an explicit "customer action" row (e.g., retry, switch region, contact rep). Enterprise customers need a canned escalation email we can paste.

amy: Pasted two customer templates below. One is short/concise, one is empathetic. Use placeholders.

amy: ```
Concise (customer-facing):
Summary: [{{INCIDENT_ID}}] We are investigating increased error rates for the inference API in {{AFFECTED_REGIONS}} (started {{START_TS}} UTC).
Impact: Some customers may see request failures or slow responses; estimated affected: {{AFFECTED_PERCENT}} of requests.
Mitigation: Engineers have deployed a partial mitigation; errors reduced for some workloads.
ETA: Next update in {{NEXT_UPDATE}}.
Customer action: No action required. If you rely on low-latency SLAs, contact {{ACCOUNT_REP}}.
Contact: support@redwood.example or reply to your support ticket.
Notes: We will not share internal logs in customer notices.

Empathetic (customer-facing):
Summary: [{{INCIDENT_ID}}] We know some customers are experiencing failures and delays when using the inference API in {{AFFECTED_REGIONS}}; engineers began investigating at {{START_TS}} UTC.
Impact: You may see failed requests or timeouts. Were prioritizing a fix and understand the impact this has on your service.
What were doing: Weve applied an initial mitigation to reduce errors for some workloads and are working on a full fix.
ETA: Next update in {{NEXT_UPDATE}}.
Customer action: If you need urgent help, contact {{ACCOUNT_REP}} or support@redwood.example.
Contact: For enterprise customers, please also cc your account rep.
```

leo: These look good. Id change the "Notes" language to include the legal-approved phrasing for data exposure: do not say "no exposure" unless legal signs off.

ravi: +1 from legal. Updated recommended language: "At this time, we have no evidence of data exfiltration or unauthorized access related to this incident. If that assessment changes, we will notify affected customers immediately." Do not use "no data exposed" or speculative absolutes.

amy: Adding that exact sentence to the customer template and also as a required internal line.

fiona: For account reps: please also include a short internal copy they can paste to customers that says what were doing and the ETA, plus a clear escalation email: account_rep+priority@redwood.example.

amy: Internal template for #incidents and pager handoffs (pasteable):
```
Internal incident brief (copy into thread):
Header: {{INCIDENT_ID}} | severity={{SEV}} | start={{START_TS}}
Observed symptom: short sentence
Scope: affected regions / services / % of requests / known customers
Hypothesis: short suspected root cause + confidence (low/med/high)
Actions taken: bullet list (commands, rollbacks, mitigations)
Next steps & owner: whos doing what and ETA
Communication plan: who writes customer notice, who posts to status page, who pings account reps
Legal/regulatory: include "no evidence of data exfiltration" line if applicable, and note if privacy/legal is looped in
Status page copy (short): one-line summary for status page
Status page copy (detail): 2-3 sentence expanded version for the incident post
```

leo: Add a tiny "confidence score" numeric field (0-100) for hypotheses so SREs and managers can triage faster.

amy: Done. Also adding an "impact level" tag: P0 (major outage), P1 (partial degradation), P2 (minor). This will drive tone + cadence.

incident-bot: @amy I can enforce the header format and insert the on-call checklist when a new incident is created. I can also require a single-line "facts verified by {{ONCALL}}" confirmation before generating a customer notice. :robot_face:

fiona: That confirmation step is great. Also, can the bot add a quick link to the customer list (so account reps know who to ping)?

incident-bot: Yes 1 I will add a configurable "affected-customers" field that expands to their contact emails. I will also add severity->update cadence presets.

leo: One more suggestion: short canned lines for status page when SLA breach is imminent, e.g., "We are investigating a potential SLA impact and will update if an objective breach occurs." Keep that gated by legal.

ravi: Approved with caveat: any phrase about SLA breach must be accompanied by a data point (ETA to confirm, or metric link) and legal should be looped prior to public wording.

amy: Action items:
 - amy: open PR with templates + examples + mappings to SEV/Px (draft opened)
 - leo: add confidence/impact numeric fields to playbook examples
 - fiona: prepare enterprise pasteable email samples for account reps
 - ravi: sign off on final legal phrasing in PR
 - incident-bot: add checklist + severity presets + confirmation flow

amy: PR link (draft): https://git.internal.redwood/ops/incident-comms/pulls/7 (contains templates, sample status page copy, and bot spec). Please review by EOD.

leo: will review now.

fiona: Ill start drafting the account-rep copy and include a ready-to-send subject line and short body.

ravi: Ill focus on the legal lines and SLA verbiage by noon.

incident-bot: Scheduling note: I will put a quick demo of the new flow on the weekly oncall sync next Tuesday.

amy: Thanks all. If we can get legal + support signoff, Ill ask ops to flip the new templates on in a soft-launch mode and watch for feedback.

amy: closing thread; please comment on the PR if you have edits.
